statement: DRAM contract prices have risen roughly 50% cumulatively this year with further increases projected, pushing memory cost into AI server bills of materials
why: Rising contract memory prices are the clearest read that memory supply is tight relative to AI system demand, and memory is a gating input for accelerator systems.

impact.mechanism: Contract DRAM price escalation signals supply shortfall and raises the memory share of accelerator system cost, tightening system supply economics.

evidence.excerpt: DRAM contract prices have risen approximately 50% cumulatively this year, with an estimated additional 30% increase in the fourth quarter of 2025 and a further 20% in early 2026.

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregator restating a Bloomberg figure; price percentages are not bit-supply growth, so the value is left unset rather than forced into the indicator unit.
